svg.title: Seconds per decision request by input tokens, by threads and questions
svg.desc: With 8 threads and two questions per request, a linear fit over the 128 confirmation requests estimates a median of 55 seconds and none over the 300-second limit. Measured: with four questions the slowest of 10 timed requests took 400.1 seconds on the longest prompt, and some requests sent two or four at once went over the limit.
svg.text: line: linear fit, estimates from it under each title

g.text: fitted over 128 requests: median 55 s, none over 300 s
